Without these components, data pipelines become black boxes that fail silently, leading to corrupted data downstream and broken business intelligence dashboards."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Comprehensive Logging Strategies"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Logging provides the granular detail needed to debug ETL failures. Structured logging in JSON format is the industry standard because it allows log aggregators like ELK Stack or Splunk to parse fields efficiently."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"import logging
import json

class CustomJsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    def format(self, record):
        log_record = {
            "timestamp": self.formatTime(record),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "message": record.getMessage(),
            "module": record.module,
            "pipeline_id": getattr(record, "pipeline_id", "unknown")
        }
        return json.dumps(log_record)

logger = logging.getLogger("ETLPipeline")
handler = logging.StreamHandler()
handler.setFormatter(CustomJsonFormatter())
logger.addHandler(handler)
logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

logger.info("Extraction started", extra={"pipeline_id": "sales_daily_01"})"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"2. In modern data stacks, orchestrators like Apache Airflow manage SLAs by triggering callbacks if a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) misses its scheduled completion time."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"from datetime import timedelta
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.python import PythonOperator

def sla_miss_callback(dag, task_list, blocking_task_list, slas, blocking_tis):
    print("SLA missed for the pipeline! Notify stakeholders.")

def dummy_etl():
    print("Running ETL...")

default_args = {
    "owner": "data_team",
    "sla": timedelta(minutes=30)
}

with DAG(
    "sla_monitored_etl",
    default_args=default_args,
    sla_miss_callback=sla_miss_callback,
